Title: Suresh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Suresh - 28 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Hema - 61 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Shalini - 27 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Neeta - 34 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The airport - check-in counters, big windows
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The living room - Night

[Suresh stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "It's very late tonight."

[Suresh lights the oil lamp in the dark room.]

Suresh: "Yes, of course."

[Suresh blows out the lamp and goes to sleep.]

Hema (excited): "What happened?"

Scene 2: The airport - Day

Neeta: "So, here we are!"

[Suresh drags his suitcase to the gate.]

Suresh: "Okay, Mom."

[Suresh hugs Mother goodbye at the airport.]

Suresh: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

[Suresh stands in the ward. Hema, Shalini and Neeta stand near him.]

Shalini: "Neeta, look over here."

[Suresh checks Mother's pulse.]

Suresh: "And then?"

[Suresh coughs and holds his chest.]

Suresh (happily): "That was such a fun day!"
